  "domain_file": "(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips :typing)
  (:types block slot)
  (:predicates
    (on ?x - block ?y - block)
    (on-table ?x - block)
    (clear ?x - block)
    (holding ?x - block)
    (arm-empty)
    (started)                ;;; indicates that a move has been made
    (free ?s - slot)         ;;; slot on the table that is currently unused
    (occupied ?s - slot ?b - block) ;;; slot currently holding a block on the table
    (slot ?s - slot)         ;;; the three allowable table slots
  )
  ;; ------------------------------------------------------------
  ;; Standard Blocksworld actions (all set (started) when executed)
  ;; ------------------------------------------------------------
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b - block)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b)
                 (not (on-table ?b))
                 (not (clear ?b))
                 (not (arm-empty))
                 (started)))

  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b - block)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (on-table ?b)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))
                 (started)))

  ;; After the first move we must respect the 3‑stack limit.
  ;; This version of putdown requires a free slot.
  (:action putdown-slot
    :parameters (?b - block ?s - slot)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (started) (free ?s))
    :effect (and (on-table ?b)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))
                 (not (free ?s))
                 (occupied ?s ?b)
                 (started)))

  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b - block ?c - block)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))
                 (not (clear ?c))
                 (started)))

  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b - block ?c - block)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b)
                 (clear ?c)
                 (not (on ?b ?c))
                 (not (clear ?b))
                 (not (arm-empty))
                 (started)))

  ;; When picking up a block that is on the table and currently occupies a slot,
  ;; we must free that slot again.
  (:action pickup-table-slot
    :parameters (?b - block ?s - slot)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (occupied ?s ?b))
    :effect (and (holding ?b)
                 (not (on-table ?b))
                 (not (clear ?b))
                 (not (arm-empty))
                 (free ?s)
                 (not (occupied ?s ?b))
                 (started)))
)",
  "problem_file": "(define (problem blocksworld-p16)
  (:domain blocksworld)
  (:objects
    block1 block2 block3 block4 block5 block6 block7 block8 block9 block10 block11 block12 block13 block14
    s1 s2 s3 - block
    s1 s2 s3 - slot)
  (:init
    ;;; initial block configuration (as given in the description)
    (on-table block7) (clear block7)
    (on-table block5) (on block1 block5) (on block2 block1) (clear block2)
    (on-table block13) (on block12 block13) (clear block12)
    (on-table block14) (on block11 block14) (clear block11)
    (on-table block3) (clear block3)
    (on-table block4) (on block10 block4)
    (on block8 block10) (on block6 block8) (clear block6)
    (on-table block9) (clear block9)
    (arm-empty)
    ;;; slot predicates for the 3‑stack limit (initially all free)
    (slot s1) (slot s2) (slot s3)
    (free s1) (free s2) (free s3)
    ;;; no slot is occupied at the start; (started) is false until first move
  )
  (:goal (and
    (on-table block3)
    (on block10 block3)
    (on-table block6)
    (on block8 block6)
    (on-table block4)
    (on-table block7)
    (on block13 block7)
    (on-table block5)
    (on block2 block5)
    (on block12 block2)
    (on block14 block12)
    (on block9 block14)
    (on block1 block9)
    (on block11 block1)
  ))
)",
  "explanation": "The domain defines the classic Blocksworld actions and adds a simple mechanism to enforce the "no more than 3 stacks after the first move" constraint. Three slot objects (s1‑s3) represent the allowable table positions. Before any move the predicate (started) is false, allowing any number of on‑table blocks. The first action executed will add (started) to the state. After that, any action that puts a block onto the table must use the `putdown-slot` action, which requires a free slot, and picking up a block from the table must free the slot via `pickup-table-slot`. This limits the number of blocks that can be on the table to three after movement begins. The problem file mirrors the ground‑truth initial and goal states, adds the slot objects, and initializes the slots as free."
}

  "domain_file": "(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips)
  ;; Predicates describing the world state
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)          ; ?x is directly on ?y
    (on-table ?x)      ; ?x is on the table
    (clear ?x)         ; nothing on top of ?x
    (holding ?x)       ; the robot arm is holding ?x
    (arm-empty)        ; the robot arm is empty
    (locked ?x)        ; ?x has been put down on the table and can no longer be picked up
  )

  ;; PICKUP: take a clear block from the table (only if it is not locked)
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (locked ?b)))
    :effect (and (holding ?b)
                 (not (on-table ?b))
                 (not (clear ?b))
                 (not (arm-empty))
               )
  )

  ;; PUTDOWN: place the held block on the table; after this it becomes locked
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (on-table ?b)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))
                 (locked ?b)            ; ;; CONSTRAINT: once on the table, cannot be picked up again
               )
  )

  ;; STACK: place the held block onto a clear block
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))
                 (not (clear ?c))
               )
  )

  ;; UNSTACK: lift a clear block from another block
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b)
                 (clear ?c)
                 (not (on ?b ?c))
                 (not (clear ?b))
                 (not (arm-empty))
               )
  )
)

  "problem_file": "(define (problem blocksworld-p52)
  (:domain blocksworld)
  (:objects block1 block2 block3 block4 block5 block6 block7 block8 block9 block10)

    (on-table block8)

    (clear block10) ; initially clear because nothing is on it
